group_assessment.counts_measured: PubMed esearch 2026-10-03: 'Chen X[au]' 146703 and 'Chen X[au] AND WWOX' 6 - a surname-initial query over a very common name, an upper bound on the corpus and NOT a group identity. The more informative measured count is 'Chen X[au] AND AP4M1' = 3.
group_assessment.weighting: An academic consortium writing the regulatory package an approved IND rests on, with two independent laboratories replicating the in-vitro arm and the GLP work contracted to Charles River. The GLP observations - per-animal DRG incidences, nerve-conduction velocities, NOAELs - carry the highest weight in this group, and the paper publishes its own adverse findings including a top-dose sensory deficit. The INTERPRETATION has an interest: the same text argues that the resulting human dose is acceptable and that NHP studies may become unnecessary. Weight the table, read the acceptability argument as an argument.
group_assessment.note: Research-group knowledge base is excluded from the public edition, so this rests on measured PubMed counts, the Methods and the declaration of interests. For common surnames the author query is an upper bound on one person's output and is recorded as such, not as a group identity.

entries.proposition: THE PRIMATE ARM OF THIS PACKAGE WAS FULLY IMMUNOSUPPRESSED THROUGHOUT, with a corticosteroid and an mTOR inhibitor, the second begun twelve days before dosing.
entries.snippet: all animals received i.v. methylprednisolone starting on day 1 until the study termination
entries.anchor: Results, 'AAV9/AP4M1 gene therapy was safe and well tolerated in WT NHPs in a GLP study', study-design paragraph

entries.proposition: AND UNDER THAT REGIMEN EVERY DOSED ANIMAL STILL HAD A LUMBAR SENSORY-GANGLION INFILTRATE. This is the sentence that separates the immune-addressable part from the part that is not.
entries.snippet: there were minimal mononuclear cell infiltrates in lumbar DRG in all AAV9/AP4M1-dosed animals
entries.anchor: Results, 'Similar degrees of minimal-to-mild DRG toxicity were observed in both rat and NHP toxicology studies'

entries.proposition: THE REGIMEN DID WORK ON WHAT IT WAS AIMED AT - the T-cell readout was null, and the authors say so with the condition attached.
entries.snippet: the AAV9/AP4M1 vector did not generate a detectable T cell immune response to either AAV9 or the human AP4M1 protein in WT NHPs under the immunosuppressant protocol

entries.proposition: THE HISTOLOGY ACQUIRED A FUNCTIONAL CORRELATE ONLY AT THE TOP DOSE, and only in the sensory modality.
entries.snippet: consistent with dose-dependent damage to sensory but not motor neurons

entries.proposition: AND THE FIELD'S OWN DISCRIMINATING EXPERIMENT IS NAMED HERE: silencing the transgene in the ganglion resolved the histopathology, which makes the residue expression-driven rather than capsid-driven.
entries.snippet: incorporation of a miRNA binding site specific to DRG resolved this histopathology, suggesting that high transgene expression was driving the toxicity in DRG

entries.proposition: THE HUMAN DOSE IS AN ALLOMETRIC CONSTRUCT FROM CSF VOLUME, NOT A DOSE ANY ANIMAL RECEIVED, and the margin over the highest tested dose is about two-fold.
entries.snippet: the toxicology studies across three species provide safety data up to an approximately 2-fold overdose in the HED
